title: Chromatic Aberration Post-Process with Particles
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements a chromatic aberration post-processing effect with an interactive particle system.

Scene Setup:
- Use an EffectComposer with a custom ShaderPass for chromatic aberration
- Camera: PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 0, 5), FOV 75
- Background: dark gray (#111111)
- Add a rotating icosahedron (radius 1.0, detail 1) at the center with a MeshStandardMaterial (color: #4488ff, metalness: 0.7, roughness: 0.3)
- Add a DirectionalLight at (5, 5, 5) intensity 1.0 and an AmbientLight intensity 0.3

Particle System:
- Create a BufferGeometry particle system with 500 particles
- Particles positioned randomly in a sphere of radius 3.0
- Use PointsMaterial with size 0.05, color white, transparent, opacity 0.8
- Particles orbit the center: each frame, rotate the particle system around Y-axis at speed 0.002 rad/frame
- Track particle system rotation in state

Chromatic Aberration Shader:
- Custom fragment shader that offsets R, G, B channels separately
- Uniform 'intensity' controls the pixel offset amount (range 0.0 to 0.05, default 0.01)
- R channel offset: vec2(intensity, 0.0)
- G channel offset: vec2(0.0, 0.0) (no offset)
- B channel offset: vec2(-intensity, 0.0)
- The effect should be clearly visible as color fringing on edges

User Interactions:
- Slider (id='intensity-slider', range 0-100, default 20) maps linearly to intensity 0.0-0.05
- Label (id='intensity-label') shows current intensity value formatted to 4 decimal places
- Button (id='toggle-particles') toggles particle visibility on/off
- Button (id='reset-btn') resets intensity to default (0.01) and makes particles visible
- Keyboard 'ArrowUp' increases intensity by 0.005 (clamped to 0.05)
- Keyboard 'ArrowDown' decreases intensity by 0.005 (clamped to 0.0)

State Management (window.__3D_STATE__):
- intensity: current chromatic aberration intensity (number)
- particlesVisible: boolean
- particleCount: number (500)
- particleRotationY: cumulative Y rotation of particle system in radians
- icosahedronRotationY: cumulative Y rotation of icosahedron
- frameCount: number of animation frames rendered
- shaderActive: boolean (true when effect composer is running)

Animation:
- Icosahedron rotates around Y at 0.01 rad/frame
- Particle system rotates around Y at 0.002 rad/frame
- Update state every frame

HUD:
- Position controls in a fixed div at top-left with semi-transparent dark background
- Show intensity slider, label, and buttons
physics_constraints: Intensity must remain clamped between 0.0 and 0.05. Particle rotation must accumulate monotonically. All rotation values must be finite (no NaN/Infinity). Particle count must remain constant at 500.
